# Source Han Serif KR

Official Adobe Korean subset OTF originals, pinned to release commit `7889f11bf31170b5d092a083b357c8c8130f89e0`. Used only to generate print WOFF2 subsets from public YAML; no build-time downloads or dependency on sources/.

License: [SIL OFL 1.1](OFL.txt). Copyright and naming records are preserved in generated subsets.
